case_title: State of Madhya Pradesh v. Preetam
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 376 IPC and sentenced to seven years imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused allegedly raped the prosecutrix while she was returning from a field with her sisters. The prosecutrix was medically examined and found to have a torn hymen and swelling, indicating sexual intercourse. The accused was seen running away from the scene by a witness. The prosecutrix's age was determined to be 12 years at the time of the incident through school records. The FIR was registered after a delay, which was explained as the uncle of the prosecutrix was not in the village at the time of the incident.
